digest.component_or_area: LLM provider substrate / parity measurement harness
propositions: Bedrock inference-profile ids must be proven invokable in account 896586841071/us-east-1 before corpus spend, with separate per-slot probe results for bare calls and temperature=0 calls.

A paired corpus run across 30 enumerated gold items (15 block, 15 advisory) must measure both sonnet and opus slots at N=3 epochs per arm, with provider as the only differing variable across the two arms.
The request payloads reaching Bedrock and direct Anthropic must be byte-identical for system prompt, messages, max_tokens and sampling parameters, with all envelope differences enumerated and valid.
The tool set offered to the model must be identical across both providers for the same logical call—same names, descriptions and input schemas.
Bedrock routing must be provider-clean: zero non-Bedrock calls on the v2 arm across all case-runs, verified by REBAR_USAGE_LOG per-call model tally.

Any capability difference that legitimately alters the payload must be explicit and recorded—e.g. temperature withdrawal on opus via supports_temperature: False override must apply symmetrically to both providers.
